svg.title: The queue on the website and in Discord
svg.desc: The same queue on the website and in Discord, kept in sync. On the Play page you queue up for 3v3 EMEA: the ring goes from 2/6 to 3/6 and you appear in the queue block below it, while the Discord queue embed shows you joining 3v3 EMEA at the same moment. A player who joins from Discord shows up on the website too. The embed also lists 1v1 EMEA, 3v3 AMER and 1v1 AMER, where other players join and leave and a queue pops into a match.
